memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "In furious anger and in great wrath the Lord uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now. The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law." — Deut 29:28-29 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This chapter closes with one of the most quoted and comforting verses in all of Scripture: "The secret things belong to the Lord our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever." After all the solemn warnings, Moses draws a line between what we can know and what we cannot. There are "secret things" — mysteries of God's purposes, the whys and hows that He has not chosen to reveal. And there are "revealed things" — His clear Word, given so that we may follow it.

What freedom there is in this! We are not responsible to unravel every mystery of God's providence. Why did this happen? Why did God allow that? Some questions belong to God alone, and we can trust them to His wisdom and goodness without needing all the answers. The secret things belong to Him — and He is entirely trustworthy.

Our responsibility is different. We are called to obey what God has clearly revealed. Instead of endlessly wrestling with the mysteries He has kept to Himself, we are to faithfully live out the truth He has plainly given. There is peace in this: we can leave the unknowable with God and simply follow what He has made known.

And God has now revealed His greatest secret of all — the mystery of the gospel, "Christ in you, the hope of glory" (Col 1:27). What was hidden for ages has been unveiled in Jesus. So entrust the secret things to your good and wise Father, and give yourself to obeying the wonderful things He has revealed in Christ.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I at peace leaving the "secret things" in God's hands?
2. Am I faithfully obeying the truth God has clearly revealed?
3. How does trusting God with the unknown bring me peace?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I entrust to You the secret things I cannot understand, trusting Your wisdom and goodness. Help me faithfully obey the truth You have revealed, above all the gospel of Christ. Amen.
